title: Exercise types
description: Hints go in the optional `hint` field (shown behind a Hint button; using it caps the grade at Hard). Prompts here are roman/ur/en triples that are reused in reveals, so the German app's trailing "(...)" hint convention is not used (PLAN D22). When the learner speaks about themselves and a woman would say it differently (maiN thakaa / thakii huuN), the base fields are the man's form and `learner_f` lists the fields a woman's version replaces (PLAN D23).

hint.description: Optional nudge shown behind a Hint button. Urdu inside `backticks`. Must not simply state the answer.

tags.description: e.g. agreement, ne, oblique. Games pick authored items by tag.

sentence_card.description: True for the 2-3 exercises per lesson that become review cards (PLAN D28). The others stay in the lesson and in practice replay only.

sentence.description: Roman and ur both contain the blank ___. `en` is REQUIRED: the full English translation.

learner_f.description: The woman learner's version: each field listed here REPLACES the whole base field (shallow); id, type, tags and retired can't be replaced. The merged exercise is validated like any other. The app shows it when settings.learnerGender is 'f'.
